text: わかった　いう…　ボスに　あいたい　なら　エレベータに　のるんだな

structure.jp: ボスに　あいたい　なら
structure.en: if you want to meet the boss

structure.jp: エレベータに　のるんだな

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら means 'if that is the case'. あいたい　なら = 'if you want to meet him'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb means 'want to'. あいたい = 'want to meet'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ after a plain verb can tell someone what they should do, and な softens it a little. のるんだな = 'you'd better get on'.
